ash: Quick thread to lock down private deploy release gates: profiles, upgrade behavior, and egress preservation tests.
neel: TL;DR: three profiles (relay-only, preserve-ip, airgap). Each has different upgrade expectations and blocker gates.
samir: Agreed. Define acceptance tests now so CI can run them against canaries.
ash: Acceptance proposals:
- relay-only: smoke + healthchecks
- preserve-ip: sticky-ip 10m test + BGP route validation
- airgap: bundle integrity + CA/TLS handshake test
neel: Sticky-ip test sketch: `for i in {1..20}; do curl -s https://handshake/echo-ip; sleep 30; done` -> require same IP in >= 99.9% of samples over 10m.
samir: Upgrade strategy: relay-only = in-place ok. preserve-ip = blue-green recommended to avoid transient SNAT churn. Airgap = scheduled maintenance window, explicit customer approval for migration that touches DB/KV.
devex: I'll add `private-quickstart.md` with example flags: `--profile=preserve-ip`, `--edge=bridge`, `--egress-stickiness=10m`, `--allowed-cidrs=10.0.0.0/8`. Also include a `network-acceptance.sh` harness.
ci-bot: ci-bot: scheduled canary bundle v1.3.0-private to staging at 2025-03-05T07:00Z :rocket:
neel: Rollout gates (canary -> pilot -> full): tenant-failure-rate <0.5%, egress-drift <0.01%, TLS-err-rate <0.1%. If any gate fails we auto-fallback tenants to relay and pause rollout.
samir: Runbook snippets: rollback annotation + route patch example:
```
kubectl -n redwood annotate deploy/redwood-operator redwood/release=rollback
kubectl patch redwoodtenant <name> -p '{"spec":{"egress":"relay"}}'
```
nash: Note for CNIs: hostNetwork may be disallowed. Add SNAT mapping on bridge and document proxy passthrough flags `--preserve-headers=x-forwarded-for,via`.
devex: Action items: 1) devex: quickstart + harness (due Tue) 2) samir: draft blue-green playbook for preserve-ip (due Wed) 3) neel: CI gates + metrics dashboard (due Fri). I'll open PRs.
nash: Thanks. If any customer asks for a custom egress IP mapping we route them to the private deploy concierge and require netops signoff.
